company_info.company_description: "The Energy Buster team is made up of skilled engineers who specialise in energy saving. Over many years, we have provided solutions for some of Australia’s largest energy users. We are now utilising our experience to provide the same outstanding results for home-owners and small businesses.Energy Buster’s best practice way to energy savings:Simple:Energy Buster has one simple goal – to cut your power bill. Our team of energy engineers cut through the complexity to simplify the process and ensure you receive the maximum financial return.Smart:The smart approach to energy saving is to invest only as much as you need to. Our engineers will find the sweet-spot between how much you outlay and how much you’ll save.Savings:Energy Buster designs solutions that will immediately lower your energy bills, while easily paying for themselves in the fastest possible time-frame.Energy Buster’s expertise does not start and finish with just solar PV and batteries. We consider a broad range of solution element options and individually design every system to deliver market leading performance and provide optimal results for our customers."

reviews.review_description: The quote process was excellent and we were advised that there would be a delay in installationExpecting it soonProcess of getting heat pump HWS installed was easy
Great customer service throughout.The system install was done neatly and met my demanding expectations.Post install follow up has been first class
Honest sales person/assessor-Nick, great feedback from Marc and efficient, tidy installation team
All good they were very helpful, after sales service has been exceptional.

Initial contact & appointment on site was quick & efficient.Pricing & quote for panels & inverter was also done within a couple of days.We did lose a couple of days due to one of their preferred finance companies not disclosing all their costs up front and therefore having to arrange thru brightE.Install was delayed by a week as the electrician advised that our meter board needed to be upgraded (at our expense) -  how this wasn’t picked up at initial inspection AND then at energy busters Quality Control stage was the most disappointing aspect of the whole process and felt like we were being squeezed / upsold for extra money AFTER the initial signing of the contract.Installation of the actual panels was done professionally & efficiently.System appears to be working well but has been only operational for 2 weeks at this stage.
Panels, inverter and batteries installed yesterday.  Connection to power board delayed til after Feb 10 so AGL can put in a new export meter.   Service good so far can answer fully in say 2 weeks.

Sales process was good, they were the first quote to contact, punctual and friendly. Install was very neat, wiring on the roof is very clean, inverter is also very neat and tidy. Price was about the mark of another quote we were tossing up against, but was a little larger system which was going to give us a bit of headroom for our use case. Meter changeover was organized by Energy Buster and they managed to get that organized for the next day.Solar is working well, we are mostly in credit on our bill so far!
Every thing was handled with professional expertise. Could not fault it

My wife and I bought our house at Mount Barker 4 years ago, moving from a 62ha farm where we had lived for 15 years off grid.  The Mount Barker house had good insulation and double glazing but NO solar panels.  That was quickly changed with SOLAR-MAN designing and installing a system with 24 SunPower panels, a Fronius inverter and Sonnen battery.  The design showed 8 north facing panels and 16 facing west.  Installers determined that only 8 panels could be mounted facing west and the other 8 were installed facing east.  Despite the changes from the design the system has performed well.Last year we bought an EV, a BYD Atto 3, and decided that we needed more panels to be able to charge the car during the day.  SOLAR-MAN quoted for 18 REC panels, 12 facing east, 6 west and a Fronius inverter.  The design had some existing panels rearranged with a mix of portrait and landscape.  This looked untidy so we sought more quotes.  Solaworx did not quote.  Energy Buster quoted for 18 SunPower panels, 8 facing north, 3 west and 7 east.  Again, the installers had to make a change to the design layout, but this was relatively minor.  The installers were well organised.

They tailored the best system for our situation and budget.Sales process was slow responding but that worked out ok for me.First class system and installation workmanship.Installation staff. were Courteous, Knowledgeable and EfficientAfter sales service from the Installers was brilliant to trouble shoot a problem created by AGL meter installer, plus correcting operator changed settings in our Tesla app.Well Recommended!

Wanted a site visit to be sure installation was feasible. Energy Buster provided this and was responsive to my requirements. Others did not do a site visit. Installation was timely and neat. New meter installation was a bit slow, but tis was the responsibility of my energy provider.
Helped with the app and how to read it. Efficient from go to finish

For any solar solutions Energy Buster is the one.They gave me the best panels and inverters for the best price. Installer's were on time and clean up after installation. Special thanks to Zac the sales guy. I would highly recommend Energy Buster for anyone.

I purchased a old house in 2022. In 2023 I realised I was due for a roof restoration as my mortar was crumbling for all my ridgecaps. This was also a opportunity to replace my old 5kw system from 2013 that was not meeting my needs. The previous owner also installed a AlphaESS SMILE5 battery in 2019. I wanted to fit as many pannels on my north and east roof as possible which was approx 8.3kw of pannels. Some other installers didnt even try to listen to this requirement.Energy Buster was the only company that came to my property to provide a quote. The other 2 was just a phone call.Energy Buster removed the old pannels as planned, My roof restoration was done in winter so i had to push my solar installation out by 2 months than the original agreed date. Energy Buster was understanding and happily kept rescheduling every week i called due to the wet weather.Something Energy Buster realised during my unintall, I was missing a grid cutover switch that the previous installer didnt provide for my battery in 2019, they happily installed one for meIn the end I now have a hybrid batterysetup where my Goodwe has 6.6kw going into my AlphaESS battery. The Alpha also has 1.6kw on it. Totalling 8.3kwHappy with the look of the Risen pannels on my roof with the black frames and Goodwe inverter.I did wait for 2 weeks, but in the ended up chasing up my electrical compliacne certificate to get a move along for a smart meter(not to be confused with consumption monitor) so i could make use of Time of Use Tarriffs.
Great team of people committed and they communicate wellTidy work and all went well
Pretty happy with the installer and hopefully the system lives up to expectations (too early to tell)
The quoting process was prompt.The installation was done professionally and the installer was extremely helpful in explaining everything.

Fantastic experience from point of contact through to completion of installation. Very professional company with great staff that kept me informed every step of process. Great customer service from Office staff through to Installers. Highly recommend.

My star ratings above may not be accurate once we turn on our system. It’s too early to tell. I was happy with the salesperson however at the time of installation the installers changed the planned layout quite a lot. They said that a tree to the north may shadow some of the north facing panels, which the salesman had assured us it would not. I have a sense from what they said at first, that it was partly to do with making the panels that had been ordered fit the roof space appropriately. We trusted that the installers hopefully knew better than the salesman. It’s too early to tell how satisfied we are as we have not yet been able to turn it on due to requiring SA power to be involved in the installation of the new metre. We have also been told this could potentially cost us up to $1600!  We were not told by Energy Buster of this possibility.  Let’s hope not. Rate apparently that SA Power has to be involved. Let’s hope too that it will be soon. We still don’t have a date since the first attempt to change the metre on May 5th was cancelled.The installers were very nice, very dedicated and very obliging as they accidentally hit a water pipe and this delayed their process but they stayed til late completing the job. Hopefully their positioning of panels gives tge results expected now that we have less north facing panels but more west facing.
Everyone involved in the installation was very professional and pleasant.
Great company to deal with from start to finish, very professional.

Sometimes we have bad experience with tradespeople.  Energy busters were the opposite.  Super professional, knew their stuff, good communication in person, and via email and on the phone.   I sat through the whole installation.  No foul language, no slacking on the job.  They worked hard, did their job very well.  Was thoroughly impressed.  Communication from their office was excellent too.

Sales/quoting process.....exemplary...courteous....knowledgeableInstallation....punctual...organised...specialists...tidyCustomer service.....friendly...attentive...grid connection organised...respectful
Sales consultant was thorough.Installation on time, installers left the place tidy

Everything was great, efficient, friendly, punctual etc. Couldn't have asked for anything more.  And didn't try and baffle us with BS, like other providers had previously - eg; trying to sell us a system much bigger than we actually needed.

Energy Buster were great to deal with, their sales and quoting process was quick and painless and their salesman new what he was talking about and answered all of my questions.We were booked in for installation after only a couple of weeks (much earlier than expected) and the installation team were punctual and professional. The installation was extremely neat, only took a few hours and they cleaned up after themselves you'd never know they were here.The installer was very helpful and showed me me how to use the system before leaving.Overall the process was so easy from start to finish. Energy Buster even organised for the new smart meter to be installed by the power company and contacter my provider, I didn't have to lift a finger.We are very happy with Energy Buster and would recommend them to anyone wanting to install solar.

These guys were brilliant the whole way through. We had a great sales person (Remi I think?) who explained everything well and gave us a great price.The installation went off without a hitch.We had it done in summer however by winter we were having some leaks from rain due to old cracked tiles.Whenever emailing or phoning Energy Buster they got onto it straight away and sent out installers sometimes in the pouring rain to fix the problem. They then came out several times to make sure all tiles were replaced and did this free of charge until the roof was perfect.This company had a very family feel about it and it didn't matter if i was chatting with the installers, the salesperson, the front desk or the Managing Director they were quick and courteous, just great customer service.
The installation is still in progress as not everything was planned correctly and there's been system amendments done and supply issues

Vedad and the team from Energy Buster went above and beyond to cater my needs, make me feel comfortable and help me fully understand my system. I could send them any question at anytime and I would receive a prompt and helpful answer. Highly recommended

Energy Busters were fantastic from start to finish. Knowledgeable consultant went through all the options and answered all my questions. The installation was seamless and done on time with excellent service. I would highly recommend them for all your solar needs.

The sales person was not as pushy as some others and the price seemed about right for a quality system.Installation was smooth and the system has been fine, apart from showing high AC voltages from time to time. Vendor suggested contacting the electricity company, which I did, but even after changing to a different phase the problem still exists. It doesn't seem to affect anything so I guess it's OK.No complaints really and pretty happy with the outcome 2 years on.(Quote was obtained via SolarQuotes but the option didn't appear in the drop-down.)
Great sales/quoting experience with Vedad. Communication after that re checking of site, installation etc excellent. Installation done as booked.

The  Energy Busters  group sales & installation plus the cost is all been excellent out of  all the quotes I've had no one else came close to them the appearance  was very important for us due to we had to be positioned on the front of house so we went with all black panels no silver lines in the panels plus black frame Enegry Busters  met all our needs very happy with there sales & quoting  they Help organise everything including grid connection.  I would highly recommend  these guys very happy.

Went with them after another company let us down, but got an equivalent price on quality panels and inverters that are performing well.Only criticism is that they didn't include scaffolding with quote which was not expected and should have been factored in. Sales guy was kind enough to recommend a more economical scaffold hire and put it up himself.Installers were friendly and got the job done in two days.Bottom line, it’s a very competitive market with high demand that puts pressure on suppliers and clients alike. Choose carefully, expect some delays and make sure you know what you’re paying up front.
Thought quote was from solar quotesWas happy with the efficiency and ability of the installers.

Sales and quoting process was great, came to my house so I could ask as many questions as I needed to in person. Can get a feel in person if bring fed a sales pitch or accurate information pertaining to my house,usage of electricity.Installation was great, guy was so helpful and we even changed location of panels on the day to get a better return on sun location. Very happy with that. Helped with installing the APP and showing me how to work it, very helpful. Very polite and friendly.

After 10 different quotes most of them telling me solar would not be worthwhile based on a Google map, Energy Buster was the only company that actually did a site visit.Their consultant Ian Jones explained everything in a professional manner .The cost was more expensive but you pay for quality Installation was organised extremely quickly. The only hiccup was the asbestos meter board which delayed connection to the grid ,unfortunately that happened over Christmas but was sorted out.Huge kudos to Ian Jones and Energy Buster. Highly recommended.
Rimu provided detailed information about the panels and inverter he was recommending. Very competitive price and great customer service.
The quote was clear and explained.Installers were polite and the panels look goodThe connection was little work from ourselves and then the bill came in and the electricity bill was zero.Happy Days

Very happy with the customer service, sales rep came out to my home to view the roof and provide different options available depending on what type of system i was looking for. Answered all my questions and stepped me through the complete process from the quote to the install.Install team arrived on time, gave me updates during the install and managed to finish the install quicker than they said it would normally take.All the communication with SA Power Network and with my energy provider to change my meter was taken care of by Energy Buster, so all i had to do was be their for the install.Would not hesitate to recommend them.

Rimu was very knowledgeable and answered all questions with no jargon or aggressive sales tactics.Install was on time, neat and the installers were polite and cleaned up well.System has been up for 9 months. Working flawlessly. Monitoring software useful for analytics of consumption and export. System outputs 8KW in good sun and a lot less in winter. Yet to have a summer. ROI will be about 5 years.

Helpful sales person. Installation was very good but couldn't divide panels to face Northwest as well because roof construction, installer wasn't aware of this when he arrived so all panels installed to face northeast. Arrived on time and did a professional job. Organised connection to grid.

The quoting and sales information was first class no problems and understanding with plenty of follow up. The installers were friendly polite and seemed very professional they also tidied up after they finished.                                 We are very happy with the the whole process. No problems.

Rimu was always courteous and punctual. He explained clearly the savings we would make and we were able to negotiate the final price. We had our panels (30) installed in one day at the end of April 2020. Our bills have gone from $1400-$1700 down to $500 per quarter and we haven't even had a Summer season using the panels yet. We are absolutely thrilled with the savings and should pay the panels off in 2.5 years.

- Salesman Rimu was prompt, courteous and had plenty of product knowledge- Process of purchasing and arranging the install was simple- Contracted installers left a little to be desired- Solar system is working very well now, overall I'm very happy

The "step by step" sales/quoting process was very easy - a couple of errors made by me on the electronic forms were sorted without any undue stress.The installation was performed in a, competent, friendly manner, with advice and manual demonstration of equipment installed.The grid connection (organised by the supplier) happened in the same week as the installation so all was up and running without any real delay.

EnergyBuster came to our home to explain the products,  process and to quote which no-one else would do - they looked after everything and the whole process was very quick.   We received excellent customer service throughout the whole process from quoting through to installation  plus after sales care.   We would highly recommend EnergyBuster if you are considering going solar.

Extremely happy with the process. Initial contact was excellent, asked many questions to tailor a system to our needs.Spent time answering our questions and took follow calls to answer additional questions.Installers were great and overall happy with the system.

Sales quote was well presented, staff all polite, tidy in dress, presentation  and attitude. No hidden issues or problems. Fronius seem to have some internet problems at varying times. App works MOST of the time.

We recently had our solar system installed by energy busters. We were impressed with Ian’s professionalism.He was patient and answered all the questions to our satisfaction. The installers were courteous and very efficient. The whole experience was was very pleasant and we would be happy to recommend them to our friends.Sanga

Couldn't be happier with the entire process from quote to installation.Ian jones came out to quote for our system and was impressive with the info he provided on the systems available, the differences in the various panels and inverters available and what can and can't go wrong with each brand.There were no pushy or pressure tactics in his presentation.The whole experience with Ian was what swayed us to go with Energy Buster because this company was the only one that actually took the time to explain everything out of 4 quotes I received.All communication was prompt and efficient from start to finish. The installers were professional and quick and also helpful in explaining how the system works from a technical perspective.I highly recommend Energy Buster.Not the cheapest out there but you get what you pay for and quality is certainly an important factor.A company that will not sell you anything cheap and nasty tells you a lot about them and their ethos in providing a service that will reflect quality in the product and the company.
good clear quoting process.Good communication and workmanship during installation. tradies were great

Quality installation, the guys where punctual, polite and informative! The install was done quickly and cleanly. Would recommend Energy Buster they kept us informed and up to date throughout the whole process!

We found the approach of Energy Busters suited us best. They were very quick to respond, with quick facts and qualifying questions and arranged for a sales representative to visit our house to discuss further. The visit was very friendly and professional - Ian wasn't pushy and was very happy to work with us to find something that suited our needs, along with providing good advice to assist.The installation process was great, they two lads were very engaged in task and i could tell they cared about the job at hand and took pride in their work. It did rain on the day and i was a little disappointed that they couldn't finish the job, but to their credit they were back at 0800am the next morning to squeeze us in and get it done.The customer service and follow up was fantastic from beginning to end, including grid connection and support.We looked long and hard before deciding and we are very happy with our decisions.Solar Quotes was a great help too.

They came out to site first before giving a quote, which was great, actually looked at my roof and not just a screen grab from satellite imagery.They use contractors for the installation, however this was not a problem, they did a good job and changed the plan to accommodate structures on my roof and removed my TV aerial as I did not want it up there anymore, which meant the panels could be placed in a better position.Overall quite happy, it was an easy process and they stayed in contact throughout the operation. I chose sunpower and fronius in the end, and they are some sexy looking panels
Ian was the first to contact me, made the effort to come out and speak to me.  The two installers were quick, efficient, polite and ran through the set-up on my phone with me.Very pleased.
Sales/quoting process was excellent.Installation went well except for an accident which was dealt with to customer's satisfaction.Excellent after installation service in programming inverter.

The installer was helpful, friendly and knowledgeable.Whilst there were a few challenges which meant I had to remove the previous system, they assisted in managing the increased costs down to minimise the negative impact on me.Installers were friendly, professional and extremely tidy.N.B. The system was 16kW, but entered as 20kW as there is no 16kW option listed.

1st contact with sales was good he understood what I wanted and came up with a plan to achieve desired result.The installation was excellent installers were tidy and respectful and fussy with the finish of the job customer service another question, original plans to power supplier submitted incorrectly causing delay while resubmitted, when it came to paying account only option to pay was by EFT which I had not been advised and had put money into credit card as deposit had been taken by this method I was surprised to find I was unable to pay this way for final account. I have finally resorted to taking out cash and will pay account that way as my options have been limited
The salesman was knowledgeable and got back to me the next day with the quoteThe installation was fast,efficient and looks greatNot connected to the grid yet, SAPN are holding the process.

Generally the service was excellent. There was good communication and follow up before and after the installation and the sales person and office staff were polite. The installers kept the site clean and were polite.

I was thoroughly pleased with all aspects of Energy Buster. The sales team (Ian Jones) were very informative and patient without any sales pressure, and certainly willing to be competitive with their quote. This was especially satisfying given that I had decided to use the flagship Sunpower panels.From there everything was seamlessly arranged from grid connection, meter upgrade and then to installation without delay.The installer, Matt, and his coworkers were incredibly delightful on the day leaving a beautiful finish and a tidy home. They informed us of their progress during the day including a change to the original setup in order to maximise both the system performance as well as aesthetics.All in all I am happy to highly recommend Energy Buster.
Installation went after amending panel location and pattern. Easy to work with.

Friendly sales person visited in person after hours and took time to understand our needs and answer all of our questions.Installers were easy to communicate with and did a very professional job over 2 days, starting early and finishing late to complete on time even with a last minute recommendation and change to our inverter to make sure we achieved the best results. No mess left behind.Paperwork with SAPN and Origin was taken care of for us.

They were the only company that actually visited my place to talk me through what they could offer for my budget. I was after a budget system without bells & whistles and they completely exceeded my expectations in terms of system size. They were fantastic to deal with, managed to find a solution for problems along the way and their installers did a very neat and professional job - extremely happy with what I got!

Rimu from the sales team explained everything solar in a professional and easy to understand manner , install date and team on time and also very helpful and friendly - very neat tidy workmanship ( installed inverter inside carport so no sun exposure at all )- running on max kw for system on good day - already have first credit back on power bill !
The sales person knew what he was talking about which made decision making and the rest easy

The quoting process was all well and quick. The communication during installation could have been better. Customer service was good except that I had to do a lot of follow ups but in the end all went quiet well.
The installation was quick and the system has been working great since day one. The software is very informative and when out and about I can always check on the performance.

The sales process was good, they came out to site as expected and totally investicated/understand our power needs.They were the first company to size the systems to our total needs, so im confident in the systems capablilty.I was very impressed with the installers, and everything went smoothly, the install was originally scheduled to be longer than 1 day, but they stayed longer than expected and finished it earlier.Can't really comment on customer service yet.

Sales & quoting was good, however there was a bit of pressure to sign up on the spot in the way of a $1,000 discount.  Luckily I knew prices and this was a genuine discount.Installation was good.  Happened when they said it would and kept me informed.  Their team leader was fantastic.Grid connection was all done.  I really didn't have to do a thing.
Simple, informative, not pushy. Installed quickly, quietly and efficiently with support after.

very good service all round, good price and quality system and helped explain any queries and answers provided to all questions.Appear to be very knowlegable when it comes to solar power.Install and info provided on time. Assisted with grid connection too.Would use Energy busters again.

Professional service from the get go. Very knowledgeable sales consultant, not pushy, simply wants to provide the best system for your needs. Installation team came much earlier than expected, friendly service with super tidy installation. Customer service after the install has also been prompt and professional. 320W Sunpower panels and Fronius 5kW Inverter with Smart Meter - 6.4kW. Would highly recommend them !!
System was installed earlier than expectedGood quality work & no mess left on roof or groundSystem installed in time promised

We are extremely happy with the solar system that energy busters supplied and installed for us. The sales team were fantastic, incredibly knowledgeable making everything easy to understand. The install team were very professional  and polite, did a great job installing the system and making the whole process hassle free ! We highly recommend Matt and his team at Energy busters for a good quality solar system at affordable prices and top notch customer service.

Energy Buster, salesman was knowledgeable polite not pushy, Installers were prompt, neat tidy work walked us through exactly what they were going to do updated at each stage of the installation and provided good details how the system works upon completion. Had a follow up email from head office checking on progress on day 1, and if we were satisfied with the installation and fixed some minor admin problem with in the hour. 10kw 32 x 320w Sunpower panels with Fronius Primo inverter.

The website was invaluable to allow us to educate us on what is involved with solar panels, inverters and providing enough technical data in laymenâ€™s terms to help with final decision.  The responses from provided installers was quick and the only reason we chose another installer ( although it was close) was that they use and recommend Sunpower panels and in the end we were happy to pay a bit extra for the 25 year product and performance guarantee.

The salesperson was very good, however he was from the commercial part of the business and only temporarily assisting. The after sales service has been disappointing (a few mistakes made and slow to contact me) but we are now booked for install (for the second time) so hopefully no more issues arise.
Fantastic service from the sales and installation team. Would recommend.
Great overall experience.No pressure but informative sales information, professional installation team, supply of quality equipment and good post sales follow-up.

I wanted to be able to monitor the whole system - production, export and household use. So that we could really do our best to maximise use of the solar element. So an ABB B21 smart meter was included. I can now get some of the info but not yet all. AGL (whose smart meter is also on our wall) are very unhelpful in this regard and I am left waiting for the finalising of the ABB app at some time in the future and hoping that will supply the info I want.Any info you have on the coming ABB app would be gratefully received!Mike Carter0417872504
The company rep seems to know his stuff, was friendly and answered all my questions to my satisfaction. He also provided a very detailed report on capital cost and estimated savings on energy cost.
